results.en:
Phase Ticks may be small, but they possess powerful attributes.
Their ability to climb on most surfaces, coupled with the power to possess soldiers, makes the Tick a valuable sneak attacker.

[impulse] (hold) to explode the Tick Sac.
[fire] to perform the Tick Leap.
[aim] (hold) for leap aim mode.
